subject.title: fix(voice-call): fail-closed media-stream auth for non-Twilio providers

question: Should this PR land the fail-closed `/voice/stream` behavior for every non-Twilio provider now, or should it first add provider-owned stream-token validation for the supported non-Twilio path?
rationale: The patch fixes a plausible authentication bypass, but it also intentionally rejects existing non-Twilio media-stream starts unless a provider implements the new hook, so automation should not choose that security-versus-compatibility boundary alone.

options.title: Approve fail-closed after proof
options.body: Accept the runtime behavior change, require focused regression coverage and redacted live WebSocket proof, then land the security fix.

options.title: Add provider validators first
options.body: Keep the PR open until supported non-Twilio media-stream paths implement provider-owned token issuance and validation instead of being rejected.

options.title: Restrict media-stream support scope
options.body: Declare `/voice/stream` media-stream support Twilio-only for now and keep Telnyx on the authenticated realtime stream path.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed after proof
recommendation.body: Accept the runtime behavior change, require focused regression coverage and redacted live WebSocket proof, then land the security fix.
